data.description:
## Context / Problem

A 344-bug corpus analysis (session log 5eb0-52a3-45f0-43e5) identified recurring escape channels: surface-parity gaps, contention semantics missed at authoring time, inert/miswired config, wall-clock flakes, unlocked store writes, auto-filer breakage, prose-only provenance rotting in code comments, and bug fixes landing without plan review. Each child was individually design-reviewed and approved by the operator (decision table in the session log; per-change experiments under /tmp/exp*.py referenced in child descriptions).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Bug provenance is observable at creation (detected-by) and trend-queryable (bug_trends metrics lens), without new required user input.
- [ ] Deterministic pre-LLM gates exist for: raw git writes bypassing the store seam, unread config schema fields, upper-bound wall-clock asserts in tests, unchecked AC checkboxes at close, historical-context rot in code comments, and oversized bug-fix diffs lacking a current plan-review attestation.
- [ ] The reconciler transport is typed end-to-end, declared field asymmetries are pinned by property tests, and pagination loops are deduplicated into shared iterators.
- [ ] Production shell logic (reconcile-bridge/canary workflow bodies, probe harness, vote normalizer) is migrated to Python per the strangler-fig policy.
- [ ] Canary/automation bug filing follows the hardened dedup pattern and a documented bug-creation contract.
- [ ] Engine-layer validation placement is advisory-enforced at plan review.
- [ ] rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills (and the shared test-design standard) encode the approved discipline upgrades: ticket writebacks, two-axis invariant sweeps, surface census, config-effect contrast, case-(c) contention triggers, gate-finding oracle upgrades, and residual-gap disposition.
- [ ] Explicit review-plan on a bug runs a real review, and the Gerrit backstop blocks oversized bug fixes lacking one.
- [ ] Code comments citing dead SHAs/run-ids/dates are remediated to ticket citations, with a CI guard preventing regression.
data.title: Bug-trend prevention program: observability, gates, migrations, and skill discipline from the 344-bug analysis
